findings.case: Fresh ordinary p4a-codex-auth candidate built by the changed bundle builder, legitimately qualified/published, provisioned while Host is IDLE as required. model_test_source.provision calls real NativePreparation.prepare at line105. Even granting a successful inert launch, the worker must call RuntimeHost._preparation_home, whose normal parent is /state/tmp. The installed runtime has read_only=true, only /runtime and /state/provider writable binds, no /state/tmp mount, and its attestation rejects Tmpfs. Dockerfile.hermes merely creates /state/tmp in the image; it does not give that path writable private runtime storage.
findings.expected: Legitimate NO_MODEL preparation creates and drains its private temporary home, commits the genuine receipt and unbound manifest, and returns PREPARED_RESTART_REQUIRED. The next ordinary Stop/Start can preserve that manifest for the panel.
findings.actual: The required preparation home cannot be created in the read-only image filesystem. Additionally, the ordinary image mkdir path is not explicitly chmod0700, while the first guard requires exactly0700. A source reproduction using the exact AST-extracted _preparation_home and private_paths.directory on an owned0755 image-shaped parent refuses 'Private directory required' before creating any home; a writable0700 parent is accepted. Provision intent has already committed at model_test_source.py:101, so a repeat is TASK_INDETERMINATE rather than repairing this missing prerequisite. No source record/AVAILABLE panel can result through this normal producer path.
findings.minimal_fix: Give the existing preparation owner a writable canonical0700 scratch parent through the normal sealed topology, preferably reusing the existing private runtime mount, and retain strict source/cleanup/identity/read-only-root checks.
